relation.note: Companion of Shaykh Idrīs. Marked الآتي — cross-ref to a later entry.

event.note: Travelled from Yemen every year for Hajj.

person.note: 615. アフマド・ブン・ムハンマド・アル＝クバイスィー（カーフで、口頭ではカーフを縛ったようなカーフで、敬虔なるしもべ）：後に述べるシャイフ・イドリースに付き添い、毎年イエメンからハッジのために彼と共に訪れた。

615. Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Kubaysī (with kāf, pronounced with qāf by common people as if a tied qāf, a pious servant): He was a companion of Shaykh Idrīs (mentioned later), accompanying him every year from Yemen for the Hajj.
